messages:
Maria Chen: Short sync on GA gating. Two gray areas: telemetry fidelity for regression detection, and multi-currency/pricing display. Need a crisp set of "must-have" vs "ship-as-flag" items.
Ravi Singh: Telemetry is must-have. Without consistent request/response events QA can't validate prompt regressions.
Tessa Park: For pricing we can do a display-only conversion + footnote for GA and ship native billing later. Docs will need exact copy.
Linh Nguyen: Legal: confirm that display-only conversions are ok (invoices still USD) or we need contract appendix. I'll check.
Omar Reyes: SRE needs an alert matrix mapping events -> page vs dashboard. If we don't gate that we risk noisy oncall.
Priya (FinOps): If invoices remain in USD, include a support playbook for disputes. I'll draft the one-liner and cost note.
Maria Chen: Proposed PROD-ENTRY: (1) canonical telemetry event set + sample payloads + alert matrix; (2) EU privacy/terms translations; (3) docs page with pricing fallback + support runbook; (4) SLO->SLA mapping doc. Optional: full UI localization, native multi-currency billing.
Ravi Singh: I'll publish the telemetry schema + samples by Thu EOD.
Omar Reyes: I'll produce an alert matrix and staging smoke checklist. Scheduling staging run Thu 09:00 UTC.
Tessa Park: I'll open a docs PR with the customer-facing fallback wording and internal support steps.
Linh Nguyen: Commercial/legal will review contract appendix by Fri.
Priya (FinOps): Adding cost appendix and recommended default: display-only conversion + invoice in USD.
staging-bot: scheduled: deploy redwood/console v3.2 -> staging @ 2026-03-14T09:00Z
Maria Chen: Owners: Ravi (telemetry), Omar (alerts + smoke), Tessa (docs), Linh/Priya (legal/commercial). Aim to signoff Fri COB. If any blocker, escalate to #release-war-room. :thumbsup:
__note: Synthetic Slack thread. Short messages to reflect typical product/eng coordination around GA gating, telemetry, and pricing fallbacks.
